name: Voice -Be Quite in the Dark-
source:
Several months have passed.
Story continues from the Good End 1 and takes place during a holiday in the town that survived the mysterious murders and now lives as if nothing had happened.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
几个月过去了。
故事从《好结局1》继续，发生在小镇度假期间，小镇在神秘谋杀案中幸存下来，现在过着仿佛什么都没发生过的生活。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
